name: Small Hill Base
title: Small Hill Base
summary: Drop point of the Small Hill Base portal, 330 m east of Wai Jhou: a Master's Sentinel statue and the Small Black Hill portal stand in a little valley at z 11, under the Small Black Hill, a 137 m black obsidian pillar crowned by a three-storey brick hall (z 148-167) with the Small Hill Base portal beside it.

shots.standingOrder: From the eastern slope above the drop-point valley, tilt 28 degrees up the black face of the 137 m Small Black Hill to the brick hall on its summit; locked position.
